title: Protected audit trail
acceptance_scenarios: Generate login/logout, clinical read/create/change/delete, support and API events; reconcile all expected events and proxy metadata. Attempt unauthorised alteration and retrieve archived logs.
evidence_after_implementation: A03-event-coverage.csv; audit-sample.ndjson; A03-tamper-and-retrieval.pdf; protected-store and retention configuration with access review.
manual_acceptance: Security reviewer witnesses coverage and protection against relevant administrator roles. Evidence archive configuration and ongoing log continuity; a fresh deployment cannot prove 12 elapsed months of retained history.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Healthcare ORM read/fetch/create/write/delete, partner reads, clinical signing and attachment streaming emit structured actor/time/record/result events without content. AUTHPRIV syslog is independent of the request transaction.
remaining_actions: Configure and witness log collection, retention, access and independent/off-host protection. Direct SQL, external systems and all export channels still require coverage review; local logs are not proof against infrastructure administrators.
